data.title: Ministry to look into fake medical records
data.description: More than 80 people have reported suspected misuse of their health records after finding medical histories and medicine claims they said they never received through the Mor Prom application.

data.title: Thamanat insists no 'Monaco deal'
data.description: Capt Thamanat Prompow has rejected claims of a "Monaco deal", insisting his trip to the principality was a family holiday and not linked to political negotiations.

data.title: Supanida, mixed duo make Taipei last 8
data.description: Supanida Katethong advanced to the women's singles quarter-finals of the US$250,000 BWF Taipei Open on Thursday.

data.title: Two men arrested in hunt for young Russian siblings
data.description: Police have arrested two Thai men while expanding the search for two missing Russian siblings in the Pattaya area, using sniffer dogs to look for clues.

data.title: Mediator Pakistan says US-Iran talks ongoing as foes trade attacks
data.description: TEHRAN - Mediator Pakistan insisted Thursday that negotiations between Iran and the United States were ongoing, even as Washington carried out a "heavy wave of strikes" on its foe in retaliation for fresh attacks targeting Jordan.

data.title: Hundreds of migrants flood into Spain's Ceuta exclave from Morocco
data.description: CEUTA (SPAIN) - Madrid said on Thursday it would despatch soldiers to Ceuta to ensure security after hundreds of migrants entered Spain's north African exclave from neighbouring Morocco and hundreds more headed there.

data.title: France, Spain eye wildfire reprieve as other blazes start up in Europe
data.description: LèGE-CAP-FERRET (FRANCE) - France and Spain on Thursday glimpsed a reprieve from some of the worst wildfires seen in living memory, which have sent hundreds of thousands of people fleeing in recent days -- among them Hollywood star George Clooney and his wife Amal.

data.title: Viagra shows potential against cancer spread
data.description: Best known as Viagra, the erectile dysfunction drug sildenafil started off as a treatment for reduced blood flow but soon saw its value spike after its other effects became clear.

data.title: Russia blamed for missile that blasted crater in Polish field
data.description: WARSAW — Poland said Thursday that a missile that blasted a 10-metre (33 feet) crater inside its territory was likely fired by Russia in its latest mass attack on Ukraine.

data.title: Middle East faces expanded war as Iran and US reignite attacks
data.description: NEW YORK — The Middle East teetered on the brink of an expanded war Thursday, after Iran and the United States reignited their hostilities and inflamed conflicts on other fronts that threatened to draw in more countries.

data.title: George and Amal Clooney flee French home due to wildfire
data.description: MARSEILLE (FRANCE) - Hollywood star George Clooney and his human rights lawyer wife Amal have evacuated their French home near the southeastern town of Brignoles after a fast-moving wildfire broke out nearby, authorities said Thursday.

data.title: TAO council chairman arrested with 400,000 speed pills on Mekong riverbank
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM - Authorities have arrested the chairman of a tambon administration organisation (TAO) in Tha Uthen district, finding him with 400,000 speed pills.

data.title: Bangkok Komatsu Sales unveils new 20-tonne hydraulic excavators
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Bangkok Komatsu Sales Co Ltd (BKS), the sole authorised distributor of Komatsu construction machinery in Thailand for more than 70 years under Siam Motors Group, recently officially launched the all-new Komatsu PC200-11M2 and Komatsu PC210-11M2 20-tonne hydraulic excavators. The new generation machines are designed to meet the evolving demands of today's construction industry, delivering outstanding performance, durability, cost efficiency, and renowned Japanese quality while reaffirming the company's long-standing commitment to providing innovative solutions and exceptional customer support across Thailand.

data.title: New movies out this week: July 30-Aug 5
data.description: Three new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: Foreign tourist to be deported after Hua Hin rampage
data.description: A Qatari man is facing deportation after a series of unprovoked attacks on six people — including dragging a woman from her wheelchair — during a violent outburst in Hua Hin.

data.title: 15 provinces warned of landslides, forest runoff
data.description: Residents in 15 Thai provinces, mostly in the North, are urged to be alert to possible landslides and forest runoff from Thursday to Saturday, according to the Department of Mineral Resources.

data.title: HYROX Craze Triggers Warning Over Early-Onset Joint Degeneration
data.description: Orthopaedic specialists warn that jumping into high-intensity HYROX training without conditioning risks severe joint degeneration and early osteoarthritis

data.title: D:CODE Sri Nakarin booking entitlement forms available from August 3
data.description: BTS Group’s Baan Chao Thai project will begin appointments on August 3 for notified D:CODE Sri Nakarin recipients to sign and collect booking entitlement forms.

data.title: Fake dentist arrested after decade of practising
data.description: BURI RAM - Police have arrested a fake dentist and two others for running a dental clinic without a licence in Muang district of this northeastern province.

data.title: ONE Championship: Anane promises ‘old Nabil’ will return in Suakim title eliminator
data.description: Algerian-Thai star Nabil Anane has promised the “old Nabil” will return when he begins the shortest possible journey back to the ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai title against Suakim.

data.title: Transport ministry speeds up high-speed rail work
data.description: The Ministry of Transport is accelerating construction of the first phase of the Thai-Chinese high-speed rail project while preparing to launch bidding for the second phase, which will extend the line to Nong Khai and strengthen onnectivity with Laos and China to support regional trade, investment and economic growth.

data.title: Rain dampens major fire in France
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Firefighters in France on Thursday were hopeful a massive forest fire was no longer spreading, as Spain said there were “almost no flames” left after a similar blaze near Madrid.

data.title: How does Hong Kong’s new end-of-life law affect patients and medical staff?
data.description: A new law allowing patients in Hong Kong to reject life-sustaining treatments when they are terminally ill will take effect on Friday.

data.title: Health starts on a Thai plate
data.description: Thai cuisine has long been celebrated for its bold flavours, but beyond a balance of sweet, sour, salty and spicy lies another defining characteristic: many of Thailand’s traditional recipes were created with wellness in mind.

data.title: Chiang Mai-Chiang Rai highway partially flooded but passable
data.description: Motorists on the main highway between Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai were being advised on Thursday to drive carefully as workers are draining floodwater from the surface in some locations.

data.title: Search continues for Russian siblings missing from Pattaya
data.description: The search continued on Thursday for two Russian siblings who have been missing from their house in Pattaya for five days, with police bringing in two sniffer dogs to assist in the mission.

data.title: Thailand awaits Georgian investigation of blogger’s death
data.description: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow on Thursday expressed sadness on the passing of Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo in Georgia, saying the cause of death has yet to be concluded and is still under investigation.

data.title: Nolan's 'Odyssey' boosts sales of mythology tales in UK
data.description: LONDON - Christopher Nolan's adaptation of The Odyssey has not only lured legions of fans to cinemas, but sparked huge interest in the United Kingdom in Homer's epic poem and other Greek and Roman mythology works.

data.title: CMA launches “The NEXT Chapter” with 5 Engines to accelerate cement industry toward Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has advanced its strategy, “The NEXT Chapter to Net Zero 2050,” through five key implementation pillars - “5 Engines to Net Zero” - under the theme ‘Accelerating Collaborative Action towards Net Zero 2050.’ The initiative aims to accelerate the transition of Thailand’s cement industry toward a low-carbon future, while elevating its role as a Climate Solution Partner, in alignment with the Thailand 2050 Net Zero Cement and Concrete Roadmap, a shared industry commitment.

data.title: Thailand to host WHO traditional medicine summit in 2027
data.description: WHO has selected Thailand to host its third global traditional medicine summit, bringing health ministers, policymakers and researchers together in 2027
